<p>An error occurred because the file submitted for batch geocoding exceeded the batch limit of 10,000 records.<br> Please modify the batch file so that it does not exceed 10,000 and resubmit the batch geocoding request. There is no limit as to how many batch geocoding requests you can submit, however each request must be limited to 10,000 records. <br> More information on how to use the Census Geocoder can be found in the API documentation at <a href='https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/'>https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/</a></p>
